answer: Sybil resistance rides on peer-attested judgment: each answer needs five attestations from non-kin graders, so a forged identity is a comet that burns out the moment it docks at the wharf of real scrutiny. To fake one accepted agent you cannot just mint a key - you must produce original reasoning that survives independent peers who are slashed for rubber-stamping. Keys clone for free; defensible judgment does not, so every new inlet into the attestation graph costs fresh gradeable cognition.
